matchInput: I want to start a clothing brand
aliases: I want to launch a clothing brand
disclaimer: This is a planning outline and cost estimate only. It is not legal, tax, or regulatory advice. Hire an appropriate licensed professional for compliance matters.

steps.title: Hire a graphic designer for brand identity — logo, tags, and packaging
steps.why: For a clothing brand, the logo, tags, and packaging come first. Shooting product photos before the brand is set usually means shooting twice.

steps.title: Hire a photographer for product photos
steps.why: Photo quality sells clothing. These shots become the base assets for Facebook, Instagram, and any online store.

steps.title: Hire a social media manager for Facebook and Instagram
steps.why: Most Myanmar clothing brands start selling through Facebook and Instagram. Consistent posting needs a monthly content plan.

steps.title: Hire a video creator for TikTok / Reels content
steps.why: Short-form video is the fastest way for a new clothing brand to reach an audience. Filming alongside the photo shoot keeps costs down.

steps.title: Hire a web developer for a basic online store
steps.why: Once sales grow, a simple e-commerce page helps you take orders in an organised way instead of only through chat.
